q: The government's new policies are designed to promote the _____ of all citizens, especially those on low incomes.
translation: 政府的新政策旨在促进所有公民的福祉，尤其是低收入人群。

q: It would not be _____ for a doctor to discuss a patient's private information with strangers.
explain: ethical adj. 合乎道德的；伦理的。
translation: 医生与陌生人讨论病人的私人信息是不合乎道德的。

q: The _____ of his profession do not permit him to tell others what a client has told him in secret.
explain: ethics n. 道德准则；伦理规范。
translation: 他所在行业的道德准则不允许他泄露客户私下告诉他的事情。

q: The company's major _____ met last week to discuss a plan to join with a rival firm.
translation: 公司的大股东上周开会讨论与竞争对手公司合并的计划。

q: Many _____ reported a sharp fall in sales as more shoppers moved online during the winter.
translation: 随着冬季更多购物者转向线上，许多零售商报告销售额大幅下降。

q: Most of the goods in the shop are bought from _____ and then sold to the public in smaller amounts.
translation: 商店里的大部分商品从批发商处购买，然后以更小数量卖给公众。

q: The dangers of driving without a seat belt are _____, yet some people still ignore them.
explain: self-evident adj. 不言而喻的；不证自明的。
translation: 不系安全带开车的危险是不言而喻的，但有些人仍然忽视这一点。

q: It took all his _____ not to shout at the passengers who were being rude to him.
explain: self-control n. 自制力；自我控制。
translation: 他竭尽全力控制自己，才没有对粗鲁无礼的乘客大喊大叫。

q: If you are _____, you have to arrange your own holiday and sick pay.
explain: self-employed adj. 自雇的；个体经营的。
translation: 如果你是自雇人士，你必须自己安排假期和病假工资。

q: _____ is common in many supermarkets, where customers pay at machines themselves.
translation: 自助服务在许多超市很常见，顾客自己在机器上付款。

q: The hotel has a _____ breakfast area where guests can help themselves.
translation: 这家酒店有一个自助早餐区，客人可以自己取用食物。

q: It was _____ to everyone in the room that the manager had already made up his mind.
explain: evident adj. 明显的；显而易见的。
translation: 房间里的每个人都明显看出经理已经拿定了主意。

q: The police have not yet found enough _____ to charge the man with the crime.
translation: 警方尚未找到足够的证据来指控这名男子犯罪。

q: His nervous smile _____ that he was not sure of himself.
translation: 他紧张的笑容表明他对自己没有把握。

q: Their fears about the safety of the new drug proved completely _____ after a lot of testing.
explain: groundless adj. 无根据的；无理由的。
translation: 经过大量测试后，他们对新药安全性的担忧被证明完全没有根据。

q: The judge ended the case on the _____ that there was not enough evidence to support it.
explain: ground n. 理由；根据（on... ground 表示基于……）。
translation: 法官以没有足够证据支持此案为理由，结束了审理。

q: The airline _____ all flights because of the heavy snow.
translation: 由于大雪，航空公司停飞了所有航班。

q: Many hotels now offer ways to save energy in order to attract _____ guests.
explain: eco-conscious adj. 有环保意识的。
translation: 许多酒店现在提供节能方法，以吸引有环保意识的客人。

q: Workers have become more _____ since the company introduced stricter rules and regular training.
explain: safety-conscious adj. 有安全意识的。
translation: 自从公司出台更严格的规则和定期培训以来，工人们的安全意识更强了。

q: The new clothes are aimed at _____ teenagers who want to look good without spending too much.
explain: fashion-conscious adj. 注重时尚的；赶时髦的。
translation: 这些新衣服面向注重时尚的青少年，他们希望在不花太多钱的情况下看起来好看。

q: As a _____ traveler, she always looks for cheap flights and low-cost hotels.
explain: budget-conscious adj. 精打细算的；注重预算的。
translation: 作为一个精打细算的旅行者，她总是寻找廉价航班和低价酒店。

q: _____ consumers want more information about the food they buy, including where it comes from.
translation: 注重健康的消费者希望获得更多关于他们所购食物的信息，包括食物的来源。

q: When the police did nothing to find her car, she decided to take _____ into her own hands and look for it herself.
explain: matter n. 事情；问题（take matters into one's own hands 表示亲自处理）。
translation: 警方对她的汽车失踪一事无所作为，于是她决定亲自处理，自己去找。

q: In _____ of the new evidence, the committee decided to reopen the case.
explain: light n. 光；了解（in light of 表示鉴于）。
translation: 鉴于新证据，委员会决定重新审理此案。

q: The suitcase is _____ enough for a child to carry.
translation: 这个手提箱很轻，连小孩都提得动。

q: She _____ a candle and put it on the table.
translation: 她点燃一根蜡烛放在桌上。

q: We traveled _____, carrying only a small bag each.
translation: 我们轻装旅行，每人只带一个小包。

q: The school website is a useful _____ of communication between teachers and students.
translation: 学校网站是师生之间有用的沟通渠道。

q: He _____ all his energy into training for the marathon, hoping to finish in under four hours.
translation: 他把所有精力都投入到马拉松训练中，希望能在四小时内跑完。

q: We were all _____ by his humorous stories during the long journey home.
translation: 在漫长的回家路上，他的幽默故事让我们大家都很开心。

q: The film festival will take _____ in October and will attract visitors from all over the country.
explain: place n. 发生；举行（take place）。
translation: 电影节将于十月举行，并将吸引全国各地的游客。

q: She _____ the keys on the table before leaving the house.
translation: 她离开房子前把钥匙放在桌上。

q: I listened to the steady _____ of her breathing as she slept peacefully in the next room.
translation: 我听着她在隔壁房间安然入睡时平稳的呼吸节奏。

q: The media has blown the incident up out of all _____.
explain: proportion n. 比例；均衡；部分。
translation: 媒体把这起事件炒作得完全不成比例。

q: The _____ patient feels less worried and sad and copes better with treatment.
explain: well-informed adj. 消息灵通的；见多识广的。
translation: 消息灵通的病人焦虑和悲伤更少，也能更好地应对治疗。

q: Take all your _____ bottles to be recycled.
explain: leftover adj. 剩余的；吃剩的。
translation: 把你所有剩余的瓶子拿去回收。

q: She made soup from the _____ of Sunday lunch.
translation: 她用周日午餐的剩饭做了汤。

q: They were able to _____ the French military codes.
translation: 他们能够破译法国的军事密码。

q: The _____ cannot be decoded without the key.
translation: 没有密钥就无法解码这个密码。

q: The diary comes _____ with a gold ballpoint pen.
explain: complete adj. 配备有…的；附带有…的。
translation: 这本日记本配有一支金色圆珠笔。

q: The builders will _____ the new school by the end of next month.
translation: 建筑工人将在下月底前完成新学校。

q: Twenty years after the event, his death remains a _____.
explain: mystery n. 谜；神秘的事物。
translation: 事件过去二十年后，他的死仍然是个谜。

q: A _____ young woman is living next door.
explain: mysterious adj. 神秘的；难以解释的。
translation: 一个神秘的年轻女子住在隔壁。

q: The bank can supply you with foreign _____.
translation: 银行可以为你提供外币。

q: The ashtray by the bed was _____ with cigarette butts.
translation: 床边的烟灰缸里塞满了烟头。

q: The dry summer has _____ the problem of water shortages.
translation: 干旱的夏季加剧了水资源短缺的问题。

q: We stayed in a _____ country house in wooded grounds.
explain: magnificent adj. 壮丽的；宏伟的。
translation: 我们住在一座坐落在林地中的宏伟乡村别墅里。

q: Each chapter starts with clear summary points and uses _____ pictures to show the data.
explain: imaginative adj. 富有想象力的。
translation: 每一章都以清晰的要点总结开头，并用富有想象力的图片展示数据。

q: The equator is an _____ line around the middle of the earth.
explain: imaginary adj. 想象中的；虚构的。
translation: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球中部的线。

q: It is _____ as one of the region's best restaurants.
explain: renowned adj. 著名的；有声望的。
translation: 它作为该地区最好的餐厅之一而闻名。

q: He gave a detailed _____ of what happened on the night of the accident.
translation: 他详细描述了事故发生当晚所发生的事情。

q: The manager had to _____ for the missing money.
explain: account v. 解释；说明（与for连用）。
translation: 经理必须解释那笔失踪的钱。

q: The monument has an _____ that honors the soldiers who died in the war.
translation: 纪念碑上有一篇铭文，纪念在战争中阵亡的士兵。

q: The monument was _____ with the names of the men who died in the war.
translation: 纪念碑上刻着在战争中阵亡者的名字。

q: I don't _____ to the view that famous people don't deserve any privacy.
translation: 我不赞同名人不应享有任何隐私的观点。

q: I need to _____ the interview for the article.
translation: 我需要为这篇文章转录采访内容。

q: The doctor may be able to _____ you something for that cough.
translation: 医生也许能给你开些治咳嗽的药。

q: The good genes _____ predicts that females will prefer to mate with the healthiest males.
translation: 好基因假说预测，雌性会偏好与最健康的雄性交配。

q: The most important _____ for entry is that applicants must design and make their own work.
translation: 参赛最重要的标准是申请人必须自己设计和制作作品。

q: She was almost 90, but still very _____.
explain: robust adj. 强健的；结实的。
translation: 她将近90岁了，但身体仍然非常强健。

q: We need to _____ our use of the existing technology.
explain: optimize v. 优化；使最优化。
translation: 我们需要优化对现有技术的使用。

q: The _____ time to plant these seeds is early spring.
explain: optimal adj. 最佳的；最理想的。
translation: 种植这些种子的最佳时间是早春。

q: One hundred and thirty people _____ addicted to the drug have been selected.
explain: chronically adv. 慢性地；长期地。
translation: 130名长期对该药物上瘾的人被选中。

q: She struggled with _____ back pain that made even simple tasks difficult.
explain: chronic adj. 慢性的；长期的。
translation: 她饱受慢性背痛之苦，连简单的任务都变得困难。

q: He will remain head of state during the period of _____ to democracy.
translation: 在向民主过渡期间，他将保留国家元首的身份。

q: He will _____ to his new role next month.
translation: 他下个月将过渡到新的岗位。

q: The cut was bandaged to _____ the bleeding.
translation: 伤口被包扎起来以止血。

q: In the laboratory, rice _____ were scraped and their contents carefully removed.
translation: 在实验室里，稻茎被刮擦干净，里面的东西被小心地移除。

q: There is a lot of public _____ to the tax.
translation: 公众对这项税收怀有强烈的敌意。

q: The speaker got a _____ reception from the audience.
explain: hostile adj. 不友好的，敌对的。
translation: 演讲者遭到了听众不友好的对待。

q: Liz turned on a radio to _____ the noise.
translation: 莉兹打开收音机来掩盖噪音。

q: He was attacked and robbed by two people wearing _____.
translation: 他遭到两个戴面具的人的袭击和抢劫。

q: Books provide children with ideas and a _____ for play.
explain: stimulus n. 促进因素，刺激物。
translation: 书籍为孩子提供想法，也是他们玩耍的促进因素。

q: The treatment of diabetes reached a significant _____ in the 1970s.
explain: milestone n. 里程碑，重要事件。
translation: 糖尿病的治疗在20世纪70年代达到了一个重要的里程碑。

q: I worked with him over a _____ of six years.
explain: span n. 持续时间，跨度。
translation: 我和他共事了六年。

q: The operation, which _____ nine countries, resulted in 200 arrests.
translation: 这次行动横跨九个国家，最终逮捕了200人。

q: The Queen _____ a plaque to mark the official opening of the hospital.
translation: 女王为纪念医院正式开业揭幕了一块牌匾。

q: The client has thrown a _____ of secrecy over the development.
translation: 客户给这个开发项目罩上了一层保密的面纱。

q: A fine drizzle began to _____ the hills completely.
translation: 一场细雨开始将山丘完全笼罩起来。

q: His performance was completely _____ and made everyone uncomfortable.
explain: over-the-top adj. 过分的，夸张的。
translation: 他的表演完全过火了，让所有人都感到不自在。

q: When she said this, there was hysterical _____ from the audience.
translation: 她说完这话，观众中爆发出一阵歇斯底里的笑声。

q: I had to _____ when I saw who my opponent was.
translation: 看到对手是谁时，我忍不住笑了。

q: His first joke got the biggest _____ of the night.
translation: 他的第一个笑话赢得了当晚最响亮的笑声。

q: I am extremely _____ to all the teachers for their help.
explain: grateful adj. 感激的，感谢的。
translation: 我非常感激所有老师的帮助。

q: We all owe Solly a deep debt of _____ for his support.
translation: 我们都深深感激索利的支持。

q: With a generous following _____, we sped across the lake.
translation: 借着顺风，我们快速驶过湖面。

q: The river _____ through the valley for many miles.
explain: wind v. 蜿蜒，曲折而行。
translation: 这条河蜿蜒穿过山谷，绵延数英里。

q: The Americans had learned Korean and spoke with a good _____.
translation: 那些美国人学过韩语，说话带一口不错的口音。

q: Preschools should _____ the function of preparing children for school.
explain: fulfill v. 实现，履行；发挥（作用）。
translation: 幼儿园应当发挥为孩子入学做准备的作用。

q: They faced the _____ of defeat in the elections.
translation: 他们面临在选举中失败的可能性。

q: The majority of holiday flights depart and arrive on _____.
explain: schedule n. 日程安排，时间表。
translation: 大多数假日航班都按时间表起飞和到达。

q: The talks were originally _____ to begin in May.
translation: 会谈原定于五月开始。

q: A strange _____ from the room next door startled her.
translation: 隔壁房间传来一声怪响，吓了她一跳。

q: She didn't _____ surprised when I told her the news.
translation: 我把消息告诉她时，她听起来并不惊讶。

q: This gives the design team a _____ basis for their work.
explain: sound adj. 合理的，可靠的。
translation: 这为设计团队的工作提供了可靠的基础。

q: All _____ to Tokyo were delayed because of bad weather.
translation: 所有飞往东京的航班都因恶劣天气而延误。

q: The company was able to _____ the crisis.
explain: survive v. 幸存，挺过（及物）。
translation: 这家公司挺过了危机。

q: They showed their approval in the _____ way.
explain: time-honored adj. 历史悠久的，因长期沿用而受尊重的。
translation: 他们以由来已久的方式表示了赞同。

q: The train was _____ the station when the signal suddenly turned red.
explain: approach v. 接近，靠近；着手处理。
translation: 火车正在接近车站时，信号灯突然变红了。

q: The school has decided to adopt a different _____ to discipline.
explain: approach n. 方法，方式；接近。
translation: 学校决定在纪律管理方面采用一种不同的方法。

q: She has been _____ in her support for the project.
explain: consistent adj. 一贯的，始终如一的。
translation: 她对这个项目的支持始终如一。

q: We have to get to the _____ of the problem before things get worse.
explain: root n. 根；根源，根本原因。
translation: 在情况变得更糟之前，我们必须找到问题的根源。

q: Her fear of water is _____ in a childhood accident.
explain: root v. 生根；根源在于，起源于。
translation: 她对水的恐惧源于童年的一次事故。

q: The sheer _____ of the building surprised everyone who saw it.
explain: scale n. 规模，范围；等级，刻度。
translation: 这栋建筑的庞大规模让每个看到它的人都感到惊讶。

q: The thieves _____ the high fence surrounding the factory.
translation: 小偷们翻越了工厂周围的高墙。

q: Once we’ve had the disease, we’re _____ for life.
explain: immune adj. 有免疫力的；不受影响的。
translation: 我们一旦得过这种病，就终身免疫了。

q: The ship had to change _____ quickly to avoid the coming storm.
explain: course n. 方向，路线；航道。
translation: 船不得不迅速改变航向以避开即将到来的风暴。

q: This new system _____ the need for paper forms.
explain: eliminate v. 消除，根除；淘汰。
translation: 这个新系统消除了对纸质表格的需求。
